title: Caesar’s coin and cautious answers
english: On Caesar and God. Pharisees with Herodians test him about the census. Showing the coin he says: [[render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s >> Bible:Matthew 22:21]]. When tested by those hunting occasions, we must neither go wholly silent nor speak rashly, but answer carefully so as to cut off every handle and secure what leads to salvation.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Resurrection: not marrying; God of the living
english: On the resurrection against the Sadducees. [[You are wrong, not knowing the Scriptures or the power of God; for in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage >> Bible:Matthew 22:29-30]]. Read it allegorically, as Paul does the slave woman and the free. Those who take marriage texts bodily err like those expecting bodily foods after the rising. [[God is not of the dead but of the living; for all live to him >> Bible:Luke 20:38]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
